about: Files the package may hold without anything in it naming them (#27 AC5). scripts/build/closure.js fails the build, and npm run package, on any other file nothing names. A directory row would cover only the .js and .mjs files under it; since #27 slice 2's bundler ships only what an entry reaches, there are none. A row changes only by review, with the reason the file ships; `until` says which change removes it.

files.why: the notices of every vendored library
Valibot's license; its code ships inside the chunks that import it
the build's identity: buildId, outputDigest, chunks, version, commit, mode, and the protocol and schema versions
every other file's path, size, and SHA-256, which outputDigest hashes
